title: Client Payment Negotiation
summary: This note details a situation where a major recurring customer refused to pay an outstanding $125,000 owed, creating a conflict between Sales and Finance regarding payment collection versus relationship preservation. The owner analyzed the project's financial health, discovered the project would remain net positive overall, and negotiated a compromise to secure a win-win solution.

key_points.text: Customer owed $125,000 and refused to pay
Sales believed they should write-off the amount to preserve relationship
Finance wanted to collect every last penny
Owner analyzed internal system and discovered project would remain net positive overall
Proposed compromise: write off half of the unpaid amount as a one time courtesy discount
Remaining balance would be deferred into a future project
Solution prevented potential financial loss and protected long-term relationship

related.title: Otis Project Management
related.why: This note details the owner's role as a project manager at Otis, which is the company where the client relationship issue occurred.
